positioning: The smart 316-steel bottle for solo operators who need 12 hours of reliable temperature—without the noise.
persona: A well-informed, understated friend who checks the specs so you don't have to.
slogans: Keep it simple. Keep it hot.
Set your temperature. Own your day.
do_say_example: Smart temp reminder, food-grade 316 steel, and 12 hours of heat retention—everything you need, nothing you don't.
dont_say_example: This magic bottle will keep your drink hot forever and is 100% perfect for every situation. Reason: unsupported superlatives like magic, forever, and perfect contradict the trusted, precise, understated brand voice.
